description: National Aquaculture Development Authority - Regulations, Culture of Coral Species on artificial substrates for export No. 01 of 2017 and the Regulation No. 02 of 2017
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the National Aquaculture Development Authority of Sri Lanka Act, No. 53 of 1998. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for importing, culturing, and exporting coral species, including permit requirements, environmental standards, and compliance procedures. While it mentions a minister's name, it does so only in the context of his authority to make these regulations under existing legislation, and does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or constitute a personnel appointment. The content is primarily regulatory in nature, establishing legal requirements and procedures.
